pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of grid or martingale pyramiding into falling knives; stacking entries is only permitted after a verified 1R profit lock on the primary tranche.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution during high-impact ATR expansion candles; mandatory confirmation via 3-period EMA slope agreement and volume-weighted order block touch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit locks at +$10.00 and execute aggressive market harvest if momentum stalls below +$25.00 to prevent evaporation of floating gains.
